body:
# 🎇This is The Unfathon🎇
## A _(soft)_ hardcore multiplayer server Like The Unstable SMP

<iframe width="200" height="112" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/bzCvutRRORU" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>


##  IPS:

```
Unstable.unfathon.net
Lobby.unfathon.net
```




From spawning you can make your way to anywhere on the unstable smp
Merchant city, Law HQ, Capital city, Northern council It is all there

### Details
-  💀1 Week Death Ban
-  ✗ hacking or cheating is a permanent IP ban and you will get redirected to our discord to make an appeal
- 💥Griefing is allowed (do at your own risk)
- ✗ No lag exploits or game-breaking bugs
- 🕜24/7 Online besides some 10 second restarts
- ❎ No crossplay, To provide no lag and make it so we have no bedrock
- 🔉 Proximity Voice chat
- 🔊Death ban sound ~500 blocks (disabled due to 26.2 update)
- 💬❌ No chat _(For more realism there is no chat so you have to talk to people in person)_
(disabled due to 26.2 update)^


### Lobby
-  Duels
-  FFA
-  Alterverse events
-  SMP queue


### ❓ FAQ

- Is this official Unstable SMP?
No, But it is meant to have builds from the unstable smp for you to play on

- Is the server free
Yes, although we will have a priority queue when we have enough players on at a time

-  Is Bedrock mobile supported?
No! We do not support bedrock to be on our server due to them not being able to communicate unless they have discord


### CREDITS

Server is run by [The Overpowered](https://www.youtube.com/@theeoverpowered)

https://modrinth.com/mod/unstable-generation is what we use for terrain stuff (disabled due to 26.2 update)

Some builds are gotten from our amazing discord!
